items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: He used to play with old man Robichoux. Oh, yeah? Yeah, he played with old man Robichoux.

ctx.x: You can keep talking around and get the tape running. Yeah.

You say he played with Chris Kelly, won't you? Played with Chris Kelly. He played with Papa Celestan. He played with Kid René. He used to play with old man Robichoux. Oh, yeah? Yeah, he played with old man Robichoux.
Just, they played the banjo, you see? Did he play guitar? Yeah. Yeah. Did he play guitar? And banjo, just banjo.
